decisions.reason: Metro data centre interconnection is central to the firm's owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centre strategy and had demonstrated adoption in financial hubs.
Optical spectrum services monetise owned fibre for high-bandwidth customers and fit the move toward high-capacity infrastructure services.
A self-service number ordering portal is cheap to run and supports real-time provisioning, though it may be folded into a broader customer portal.
Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service, but it still yields revenue from existing customers, so a phase-out is more likely gradual than within one year.
